text: dsh-cubox 是面向 DSH Web 的 Cubox 收藏同步插件，通过主机插件注册 agent 工具、Web 设置面板、API 路由和可选定时器。它可按时间同步收藏与标注、按关键词和状态筛选收藏，并在配置目录时导出 Markdown；还可将收藏整理为 AI 简报，或把新增标注汇总后发送到 Flomo/Notion。适合希望在 DSH 中检索、整理和归档稍后读内容的用户。需要 Cubox API 扩展链接；LLM、Flomo、Notion 连接按需配置。

dsh-cubox connects Cubox to DSH Web with agent tools, a settings panel, and optional scheduled sync. It syncs and filters bookmarks and annotations, exports Markdown, and can create AI briefs or send digests to Flomo or Notion. A Cubox API extension link is required; other integrations are optional.
想在 DSH 里搜索和整理 Cubox 收藏。
帮我把稍后读文章同步成 Markdown 文件。
I want to sync my saved Cubox articles and highlights into DSH.
dsh-cubox 的功能「同步与归档」：调用 cubox_sync 拉取指定天数内的收藏和标注，保存本地快照，并可按设置导出每条收藏的 Markdown 文件。
dsh-cubox 的功能「收藏查询与标注摘要」：用 cubox_cards 按关键词、时间、已标注、星标或已读状态筛选收藏；启用后，同步还可将新增或变更标注整理并发送至所选目标。
dsh-cubox 使用前须知：同步会向所配置的 Cubox 服务器发送带 API 扩展 token 的请求以读取收藏与标注；启用 LLM 简报或 digest 整理时，相关内容会发往配置的模型服务。
dsh-cubox 使用前须知：开启 Flomo 推送或选择 Notion 导出后，标注摘要会发送至对应服务；这些集成需要各自的 webhook/API 凭据或 Notion token。
dsh-cubox 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 43 天；提交数 19；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-cubox README · dsh-cubox：> **English** | [**中文**](README.zh.md)

Cubox sync for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): scheduled sync of your Cubox collection, with an **AI daily brief** generated from your own prompt template and written straight into Obsidian — via the same `/c/api/cli` endpoints the official cubox-cli uses. Agent tools plus a web settings panel.

dsh-cubox README · Features：- **Scheduled sync** — a timer pulls your latest bookmarks into a local cache (`~/.dsh/dsh-cubox-cache.json`) every N minutes (default 60, configurable; 0 disables the timer). Manual sync anytime with `cubox_sync`.
- **AI daily brief** — write your own prompt template (e.g. "今日收藏简报", `{collection}` is replaced with the formatted collection for the sync window: title / source / summary / annotations). When an LLM key is configured, every sync generates a brief into the output dir — `今日收藏简报-YYYY-MM-DD.md` for a 1-day sync, `最近N日收藏简报-YYYY-MM-DD.md` for wider windows (each window gets its own file).
- **Markdown export** — set `outputDir` and optionally keep one markdown file per card (frontmatter + title + description + Cubox/original links + annotations, same layout as the official Cubox Obsidian plugin). Toggle `exportCards` off to write only the AI brief.
- **Query** — `cubox_cards` filters by keyword, time window, annotated/starred/read status.
- **flomo annotation sync** — after each sync, newly created / changed annotations (highlights + thoughts) are pushed to [flomo](https://flomoapp.com) as a daily digest (card title + link + annotations). It reuse

dsh-cubox README · Configure：1. Open Cubox preferences → Extensions & Automation → API Extension → enable it and copy your unique link (e.g. `https://cubox.pro/c/api/save/abcd12345`).
2. Give the link to the plugin — either in the settings panel (Settings → Cubox), or just ask the agent:

```text
   帮我配置 Cubox，API 链接是 https://cubox.pro/c/api/save/abcd12345
   ```

dsh-cubox README · Configure：The agent calls `cubox_config` to persist it. `cubox.pro` is the default server; `cubox.cc` is the international instance (auto-detected from the link).
3. (Optional) Set the export dir + AI brief: choose the local folder, paste an OpenAI-compatible API key (DeepSeek by default), and edit the prompt template. `{collection}` is replaced with today's collection list.

Then:

```text
同步一下今天的收藏                → cubox_sync (days=1)
查一下收藏里关于 LLM 的文章       → cubox_cards (keyword="LLM")
```

dsh-cubox README · Configure：> The API link and the LLM key are credentials — anyone holding them can read (and modify) your Cubox data or spend your LLM quota. They are stored in `~/.dsh/dsh-cubox.json` (mode 0600). To rotate, refresh in the Cubox API-extension page, then re-configure.

dsh-cubox README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `cubox_status` | Connection & cache status |
| `cubox_config` | Set / clear `apiLink`, `server`, `token`, `syncMinutes`, `outputDir`, `exportCards`, `llm*`, plus the digest options `flomoEnabled` / `exportDest` / `flomoTag` / `flomoMinAgeMinutes` / `usePrompt` / `exportPrompt` / `notion*` |
| `cubox_sync` | Pull the last N days (default today) into the local cache + export markdown + AI brief + digest push |
| `cubox_cards` | Query the collection (keyword / days / annotated / starred / read) |
| `cubox_flomo` | Push new / changed annotations to flomo now (`days` window / `force` bypass min age / `tag` override) |

dsh-cubox README · Notes：- The public Cubox "open API" only accepts saves; reads go through the internal `/c/api/cli/*` family (same endpoints as the official [cubox-cli](https://github.com/OLCUBO/cubox-cli)).
- The sync cache is a plain JSON snapshot (cards + today's annotations, deduped by id, newest first) — agents can answer "what did I save" without extra round trips.
